title: ArchMaker Rule (RULE-*)
description: Typed declarative AST evaluating a condition to an effect (block / suggest / derive / change / lock). Operators follow docs/07-validation/operator-spec.md. The condition is a CLOSED union: every operator token belongs to the normative vocabulary in $defs.operator. An unknown operator matches no variant and is rejected here; the runtime must still emit the blocking diagnostic AM-RULE-009 (never evaluate it as false). Shared identifiers ($defs.entityId, $defs.capabilityId) and the severity vocabulary live in common.schema.json and are referenced by $id. Contract state: v0 (draft).
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R8, AUD-017). Duplicated $defs.entityId/$defs.capabilityId extracted to common.schema.json and referenced by $id; local rule-only $defs kept here. $defs.operator is the closed normative vocabulary (canonical, legacy-migration-only and v1-deferred tokens are annotated per operator). count_gt is legacy (migration-only, rewritten to count with a threshold, never executed by the new runtime); target_is is deferred to v1. additionalProperties:false at every object edge; unknown fields rejected.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity emitted by the rule. Canonical vocabulary from common.schema.json (errors-events.md is the single source of truth).

blocking.description: Whether the emitted diagnostic blocks manifest construction. Must be consistent with severity (error => blocking:true; warning/info => blocking:false).

when.description: Boolean condition evaluated over the domain (pipeline stage 8).

action.description: Effect applied when the condition holds.

target.description: Target step affected by change or derive effects (resolution/objective).

allowed.description: Options the effect may select on the target.

diagnosticCode.description: AM-* code emitted by the rule; the canonical numeric assignment lives in docs/04-interfaces/errors-events.md (single source).

note.description: Free-form human note. Not part of the canonical hashed payload semantics beyond the document field rules.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: RULE- prefix plus at least two upper-case alphanumeric segments.

diagnosticCode.description: Diagnostic code AM-<FAMILY>-<NNN>; catalogued in docs/04-interfaces/errors-events.md.

action.description: Closed effect vocabulary. block stops construction; suggest informs; derive computes a value; change may reassign the target within allowed; lock freezes the target.

operator.description: Closed normative vocabulary of rule operators (names). Canonical/executable: all, any, not, eq, ne, in, required, selected, count, provides. Legacy (migration-only, never executed by the new runtime): count_gt. v1-deferred (not used by the MVP): target_is. Every condition variant constrains its property names to this enum, so an operator token outside it can never validate.

targetId.description: Export or execution target identifier (DEC-001), e.g. archinstall. Single segment.

countExpr.description: Term operator count: integer expression returning the number of effective selections of a reference. A term, not a boolean; usable as an operand of eq/ne/in.

operand.description: A comparison operand: an entity reference (DEC-002 vendor.kind.id), a boolean, an integer or a count expression. Literals are typed; there is no untyped string literal.

condition.description: Closed boolean-expression union over the supported operators. Exactly one variant matches; any other operator key is rejected.

allExpr.description: all(List<Expr>) -> bool: true iff every listed expression is true. minItems 1 (empty conjunction is not representable).

anyExpr.description: any(List<Expr>) -> bool: true iff at least one listed expression is true. minItems 1 (empty disjunction is not representable).

notExpr.description: not(Expr) -> bool: logical negation of a sub-expression.

eqExpr.description: eq(T,T) -> bool: equality of two operands. Exactly two operands.

neExpr.description: ne(T,T) -> bool: inequality of two operands. Exactly two operands.

inExpr.description: in(T,List<T>) -> bool: membership of a value in a non-empty list.

requiredExpr.description: required(ValueRef) -> bool (canonical, ratified 2026-10-05): true when the referenced entity has cardinality >= 1.

selectedExpr.description: selected(Id) -> bool (canonical): true when the option Id is selected in the draft.

countGtExpr.description: count_gt(ValueRef,integer) -> bool. LEGACY, migration-only: the v5.1 migration rewrites count_gt(Ref,n) to the normalized count term with a threshold (gt(count(Ref), n)); the new runtime never executes count_gt. Retained so inherited documents can be parsed and migrated.

providesExpr.description: provides(Capability) -> bool (canonical): true when the resolution provides the capability (evaluated in pipeline stage 9).

targetIsExpr.description: target_is(TargetId) -> bool. DEFERRED to v1 (VAL-TARGET): not used by any MVP rule; the schema keeps it representable so v1 documents can be typed without a breaking change. Evaluates the active export/execution target (DEC-001).
